name: Haus Edmund
beschreibung:
Commanding panoramic views of Soelden's dramatic 3,000-metre peaks, Haus Edmund features comfortable holiday flats. It is an ideal launching pad for summer hiking and winter skiing.

The Gaislachkogl and Giggijoch cable cars and the village center are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Edmund in Soelden offers well-maintained apartments on a sunny hillside in Oetztal.
